name: So huyet
summary: Sò huyết is the blood cockle on the town menu and among the live shellfish at Hàng Dương. Dân Việt names one cook, sò huyết la cót, and does not print the method. Thanh Niên lists sò among the animals you point at and the stall cooks.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022. Thanh Niên, 11 Mar 2019.
howToEat: Cooked to order, at lunch or dinner.
Dân Việt prints 380,000 VND a kilogram on 2 Oct 2022, including the cooking. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
where: The town streets, or chợ hải sản Hàng Dương. The hour is Check on arrival.
